value.residual: The retained IR validator admits a closed upsert_input_object declaration and rejects unknown payload/schema fields, open object schemas, and contradictory idempotent/ledgered declarations. Quint and Lean check independent bounded/reference semantics for exact active-definition pins, schema/ontology guards, one effect/event, stale/no-op behavior, and stable replay. No HTTP executor or custom ActionIR runtime is retained. Relation effects, deletes, field templates, arithmetic, domain-specific invariant programs, task-result coupling, extraction/refinement, and arbitrary custom ActionIR remain open.
